text:
maria: Morning — saw weird autoscaler oscillation in us-west-2 between 08:12 and 08:25 UTC. Traffic spiked (≈780k tokens/min) and we had 3 scale-ups followed by immediate scale-downs. Ended up burning ~14 GPU-hours extra during the flapping. Logs: https://internal/logs/1762507890

autoscale-bot: Alert: repeated scale events detected for cluster=rw-usw2-poolA; events=6; avg_scale_time=45s; failed_scaleups=2; current_burst_tokens=0.4

ashwin: I saw this in the metric dashboard — the autoscaler is too eager to scale down once burst finishes. Two quick ideas:
- increase scale_down_delay from 120s -> 600s
- add a hysteresis window of 180s where we ignore small drops (<10% of agg_load)

lee_w: Agree with hysteresis. Also concerned about cost if we keep GPUs up too long. Proposal: introduce a "reservation lattice" pattern — keep a small steady pool pinned (min_gpus) and a separate burst pool with explicit borrow rules and a burst-penalty counter so we don't oscillate.
Example:
```
autoscaler:
  steady_pool_min: 30
  burst_pool_max: 80
  scale_down_delay: 600
  hysteresis_window: 180
  burst_penalty_window: 900  # penalty duration after a burst
```

jordan: Nice. Let's A/B test on canary cluster (rw-usw2-canary). Can we try these params for 48h and track: extra GPU-hours, P95 latency, failed_scaleups? If metrics look good we roll to prod.

ashwin: I'll push the canary. Patch I'm planning:
```
kubectl patch configmap autoscaler-config -n infra --type merge -p '{"data": {"scale_down_delay": "600", "hysteresis_window": "180", "burst_penalty_window": "900"}}'
```
We'll also enable debug logging for scale decisions.

maria: Sounds good. Two quick asks:
1) lee_w — please design the reservation lattice borrowing rules (max borrow per 10m, soft cap) and post here by EOD.
2) ashwin — deploy canary and add dashboard panels for burst_penalty and borrow_count. Run for 48h and report.
I'll coordinate communication to CS if we need to adjust rate limits.

lee_w: On it. Initial borrow rules:
- borrow_max_per_10m: 10 gpus
- soft_cap: 70% of burst_pool_max
- when borrow_count > 15 in 30m => extend burst_penalty_window by +600s

jordan: Added a quick tracker doc: https://internal/doc/autoscale/hysteresis-test

maria: Thanks. If anything spikes unexpectedly ping @oncall. We'll reconvene after the 48h canary. :thumbsup:
